title: A feed that is safe to retry
prompt: `transactions` is one delivery of the bank's feed: new transactions and new states of ones already in the table. Deliveries are retried, so `solve` applies this one twice. Fix `apply_feed` so the Delta table ends up right however many times a delivery is applied.
rules: The table has one row per `transaction_id`.
A feed row for a transaction already in the table replaces it, every column. A new transaction is added. Transactions the feed doesn't mention stay as they are.
The feed may send a transaction more than once, always as an identical copy. An empty feed changes nothing.
Applying the same delivery twice must give the same table as applying it once. Don't change `start_table` or `solve`.
hints: Run the starter on the sample: which transactions appear more than once, and why?
A MERGE on the key updates rows that match and inserts the rest, so a second run finds everything already there.
A merge compares the feed with the table, not with itself. Remove repeated deliveries from the feed first.
starter:
import shutil
from datetime import datetime
from decimal import Decimal

from delta.tables import DeltaTable
from pyspark.sql import functions as F


def start_table(transactions, path):
    # Yesterday's table. Don't change this.
    shutil.rmtree(path, ignore_errors=True)  # start from an empty folder on every run
    yesterday = spark.createDataFrame(
        [
            ("T000003", "A00001", "M003", datetime(2026, 1, 26, 16, 39, 39), "purchase", "card_present", "debit", Decimal("27.90"), "USD", "pending"),
            ("T000005", "A00008", None, datetime(2026, 1, 31, 6, 31, 56), "deposit", "branch", "credit", Decimal("3100.00"), "USD", "posted"),
            ("T000050", "A00003", None, datetime(2026, 1, 2, 9, 0, 0), "deposit", "branch", "credit", Decimal("120.00"), "USD", "posted"),
        ],
        transactions.schema,
    )
    yesterday.write.format("delta").save(path)


def apply_feed(feed, path):
    # Apply one delivery of the bank's feed to the table.
    feed.write.format("delta").mode("append").save(path)


def solve(transactions):
    path = "/tmp/bank/transactions"
    start_table(transactions, path)
    apply_feed(transactions, path)
    apply_feed(transactions, path)  # the delivery is retried
    return spark.read.format("delta").load(path)
